================================================================================
Byte-by-byte Description of file: plan_bin500au.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units   Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 15 A15    ---     Most commonly used name of the parent star
  16- 25 A10    ---     Alternate name (if any, otherwise "X")
  26- 31 F6.3   Msun    Mass of the parent star
  32- 37 F6.3   Msun    Mass of the companion star
  38- 45 F8.2   pc      Distance to the system
  46- 47 I2     ---     Method of detection (1=transit, 2=RV, 3=other)
  48- 54 F7.2   au      semi-major axis of the binary (if orbit known) or projected separation between the 2 stars
  55- 61 F7.3   ---     eccentricicy of the binary's orbit (if orbit unknown then e=99.)
  62- 63 I2     ---     Number of detected planets orbiting the star
  64- 71 F8.4   au      semi-major axis of the outermost planet in the system
  72- 77 F6.3   ---     eccentricity of the outermost planet in the system
  78- 86 F9.5   Mjup    estimated mass of the outermost planet in the system
  87- 93 F7.2   au      critical distance to parent star for orbital stability (assuming coplanarity and using empirical formula of Holman&Wiegert(1999))
  94-101 F8.3   deg     inclination between binary and planetary orbital planes (if unknown then 999.)

Note 1: complete for all S-type planet-hosting binaries of separation <500au
Note 2: when only the radius of the planet is known, its mass is (very) roughly estimated with a crude R_plan**3 scaling.
Note 3: for notes and references on individual systems, please go to exoplanet.eu/planets_binary_notes
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
